title: NetherRoofBreakthrough
description: Never get stuck again on the Nether roof! find 1 block thick  spots easily.
body: Its just a small Mod to help you find spots for breaking the nether roof, you can use it to traverse the nether faster, or just find a way out if you forgot your obsidian but still got the 2 pistons, 2 tnt 1 lever 2 obsidian and your trapdoor or whatever method you want to employ.
